youtube.title: He Walked Into a Parking Lot and Vanished | Jimmy Hoffa
youtube.description:
On July 30, 1975, former Teamsters president Jimmy Hoffa waited in the parking lot of the Machus Red Fox restaurant outside Detroit for a meeting with two men tied to organized crime. He was never seen again. Police dogs later found his scent in a borrowed car; the FBI's 1976 'Hoffex' memo concluded he was murdered at the behest of organized crime. Searches as recent as 2021 have found nothing.

📂 Case File #013: Jimmy Hoffa

Sources: FBI 'Hoffex' memo (1976, released 2006); overview and citations: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Hoffa
Images: Jimmy Hoffa (public domain); Mercury Marquis by Mercury/Ford ad via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0; FBI seal (public domain).
